name: logos-obsidian-sync
title: Logos → Obsidian Sync
description: Import and continuously re-sync your Logos Bible Software notes into an Obsidian vault.
author: barkernotbob

commands.name: sync
commands.title: Sync Logos Notes
commands.subtitle: Logos → Obsidian
commands.description: Read the Logos notes database and update your Obsidian vault. Runs on demand and hourly in the background.

preferences.name: vaultPath
preferences.title: Obsidian Vault
preferences.description: Full path to the folder that contains your Obsidian notes (e.g. ~/ObsidianVault).

preferences.name: downloadImages
preferences.title: Images
preferences.label: Download note images into the vault
preferences.description: Turn off to skip image downloads (faster, no network).

commands.name: search-notes
commands.title: Search Notes
commands.subtitle: Logos
commands.description: Search your Logos Bible notes (text, notebook, tags, reference) and open them in Logos. Reads Logos directly — no Obsidian required.

preferences.name: logosDataDir
preferences.title: Logos Data Directory
preferences.description: Optional. Path to your Logos4/Documents folder if the notes database isn't auto-detected. Leave blank to auto-detect.

preferences.name: toolkitPath
preferences.title: Toolkit Folder
preferences.description: Folder that contains logos_to_md.py and logos_notes_json.py (the unzipped LogosImport-Toolkit).
